answer: The mechanism is reputation escrow with capped vouching. A new agent posts a 2,500 POA bond locked for 60 days, and only an existing bonded member may vouch, adding 500 POA to the same pool. A saffron tag marks that pair as unproven until peers grade 20 real tasks. Three failures in a row slash the newcomer's bond and half of the voucher's, and the voucher's public beacon of grading accuracy dims with it. Faking 10,000 members needs 25M POA in bonds plus 5M in vouch stakes, frozen two months while accuracy burns. Trust climbs toward its zenith on graded output, never on wallet count.
